business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)到[Q03](#research-q03)同窗网页/代码workflow50%超装饰25%，未独立验业务正确阻75%；桌面+独立browser工具入口delivery/reach50%超单内置页25%，发布/实际用户兼容与扩散未核阻75%；economics未知：本轮未展开usage/计费控制及全产品资源机制，不能把未审当无增量0或按截图上界冒充节费；商业总分未知，不影响已核前三维和采用评分。

recommendation.reason: 愿意使用独立资料目录、复制工作区并确认有效只读模式的DSH用户，可用 DeepSeekGUI 在同一会话旁查看代码和公开网页，并对照可见工具轨迹。相比原生Web加独立浏览器，源码支持真实内嵌pane与分层检查，但Full access敏感helper存在正常页面误拒的源码条件，底座循环属于沿用能力，动作回包也不能代替业务完成验收。若目标与当前页面不符、模式超出允许范围或写入结果未知，应暂停后续操作，核真实网页与文件状态后退回原有编辑器和浏览器流程，避免重放外部动作。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)代码/网页同窗50%超泛桌面25%，真实频率/需求对照阻75%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)/[Q03](#research-q03)真实pane+分层检查50%超外观25%，已有自动化替代与业务边界阻75%。

evidence.rationale: 实际入口/底座反馈/native/权限/SSRFcallee见[Q01](#research-q01)至[Q04](#research-q04)，源码50%超README25%，未成品/运行与对照阻75%。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)独立home/副本/只读可退50%超生产写入起步25%，模型/资料/后端进程与平台恢复负担阻75%。

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 桌面托管/pane | 同窗加载Harness与外部网页 | overlay可省略，成品与全局隔离未验证 |
| browser_navigate | 打开URL回最终地址/标题 | URL/DNS/proxy检查，不等页面可信/业务无副作用 |
| browser_snapshot | 输出可访问树/文本与refs | refs role/name、page/URL，非业务不可变身份 |
| browser_screenshot | 获取页面图像为本地PNG | 隐藏/错误页面可失败，写磁盘/输入模型的隐私成本 |
| browser_wait | 有上界等待页面 | 时间过去不等任务成功 |
| browser_tabs | 查看/选择/管理浏览页 | 非任意桌面程序控制，目标切换要重新核 |
| browser_click | 点击定位元素 | 只读拒绝；后果启发式升级审批，敏感分支Full access正常非空URL可被helper误拒 |
| browser_type | 向元素填入文本 | 是页面交互非只读；pressEnter走helper，Full access误拒条件见Q03 |
| browser_scroll | 滚动页面/元素 | 按交互mode gate，不作业务完成依据 |
| browser_keyboard | 发送按键 | 可提交键走helper，Full access误拒条件见Q03；任意JS后果未穷审 |
| browser_hover | 悬停目标 | 页面交互有mode边界，不代表无副作用 |
| browser_submit | 对目标执行提交动作 | 一般模式审批；Full access不调reason可在正常页面误拒；submitted非受理证明 |
| 底座模型工具循环 | 将真实工具结果再交模型决策 | 沿用DSH，不是GUI独创新推理或任务正确保证 |

data.reports:
# DeepSeekGUI > 第三方DSH Fork桌面工作台，沿用真实模型工具循环并接入可见内嵌浏览器；页面目标、有效权限、网络地址和业务完成是不同边界。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[See-Sol-Lab/DeepSeekGUI](https://github.com/See-Sol-Lab/DeepSeekGUI) - **版本号**：1.2.1（桌面应用；根DSH工作区0.2.1-rc.2，browser插件0.2.1）（[固定提交 1e913d8b38b23df083bd6d3852b623f93210360a](https://github.com/See-Sol-Lab/DeepSeekGUI/tree/1e913d8b38b23df083bd6d3852b623f93210360a)） - **版本日期**：2026-10-24（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 固定源闭合桌面spawn/UI settle、底座工具结果回下一模型、browser注册→bridge/CDP/native pane及关键权限/网络callee。未运行/验编译发行物或全审大Fork；限独立home/复制workspace有效只读试用。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：需要在DSH会话旁查看代码与公开网页的用户；本轮只核代表链，不扩到README全部Git/PR/记忆/迁移功能，见[Q01](#research-q01)。 - **亮点**：统一桌面托管和真实内嵌浏览器、分mode工具/目标与网络检查组合；已有护栏范围见[Q03](#research-q03)，独立能力主表只列本轮已核操作。 - **思考**：Full access内部不发审批，但approveSubmission未填URL导致正常非空页面敏感动作误拒的源码条件；一般模式不一概失败。role/name/URL/facts不等业务对象，clicked/submitted不等服务受理，SSRF不等网页可信或整机隔离，见[Q03](#research-q03)。 - **建议**：先修Full access helper的URL误拒；在已有审批后facts复比之外做有限业务的后置事实核验和未知结果对账；受控基线/指标/停止条件见[Q05](#research-q05)。 采用建议：只读会话与复制workspace先核代码/公开网页任务，明确模型和页面数据流；不基于本轮直接授权Git/PR或真实网页写入，见[Q04](#research-q04)、[Q05](#research-q05)。 ## 核心贡献 统一桌面托管和真实内嵌浏览器、分mode工具/目标与网络检查组合；已有护栏范围见[Q03](#research-q03)，独立能力主表只列本轮已核操作。 ## 关键质疑 Full access内部不发审批，但approveSubmission未填URL导致正常非空页面敏感动作误拒的源码条件；一般模式不一概失败。role/name/URL/facts不等业务对象，clicked/submitted不等服务受理，SSRF不等网页可信或整机隔离，见[Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 先修Full access helper的URL误拒；在已有审批后facts复比之外做有限业务的后置事实核验和未知结果对账；受控基线/指标/停止条件见[Q05](#research-q05)。 独立home和受控站点比原生组合的目标/授权/真实后置结果；注入同页换对象/审批后变化/丢响应并测重复写、恢复工时与资源，见[Q05](#research-q05)。 ## 场景与替代办法 需要在DSH会话旁查看代码与公开网页的用户；本轮只核代表链，不扩到README全部Git/PR/记忆/迁移功能，见[Q01](#research-q01)。 原生DSH Web加编辑器/独立浏览器与既有自动化工具；底座Loop/Playwright/Chromium和标准隔离配置不算新算法。 ## 依赖与流程 桌面/Harness/profile资源需匹配，模型/浏览器/CDP/网络与资料权限按所选功能；完整四列表见[Q04](#research-q04)。 启动/挂载→会话模型工具循环→browser实际pane→人核结果/退出；完整活动步骤表见[Q01](#research-q01)，结果回流见[Q02](#research-q02)。 ## 成本与效果 首次固定版本/独立home/副本；持续模型/截图/浏览资源，失败未知写结果先对账，退出核子进程与资料；现金与人工四阶段表见[Q04](#research-q04)。 可见目标/权限/网络门与工具回包能辅助操作，不能证明业务成功或节省总工时；效果四项表见[Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标**：限定桌面/底座循环/浏览器代表链核直接贡献、采用失败与生产方向。 ### Q01 · 真实对象、应用版本和桌面启动增量是什么？ **研究主题**：场景与需求、功能与机制、贡献与相对优势 #### 完整回答 DeepSeekGUI是第三方DSH Fork桌面工作台，不是把整个root安装为单plugin。应用apps/deepseekgui为1.2.1，root工作区/DSH为0.2.1-rc.2，内置browser插件又为0.2.1；不将单版本当各包/线上发行统一。主入口lib/main.js由rootDir src→outDir lib的TS构建对应src/main.ts；固定树未见该应用lib/main.js，故本轮核源码接线而非已编译发行物等价。 面向希望同一窗口处理代码会话和网页的DSH用户，本轮限桌面启动、底座真工具循环与内嵌浏览器代表链，不因README Git/PR/记忆/搬家/更新列表就全计已核可用能力。默认launcher managed home/web；launch解析profile与可用overlay，browser/workbench/skills等找不到可省略，不能只凭包在树中许每次都挂载。真实main spawn launch.command/args/env，拿readiness/会话凭据、设置httpOnly/strict cookie、loadURL到Harness view，再等官方UI和客户端settle。启动/插件settle健康不等模型任务成功；恢复机制/所有安全边界本轮未全审。桌面chrome view有隔离/禁Node/sandbox/preload，外部网页pane另partition且不配该preload；不据这些配置承诺所有工具有OS沙箱。 | 步骤 | 执行者与动作 | 结果/失败 | |---|---|---| | 启动 | 桌面选home/profile，解析overlay并spawnDSH | 缺可选插件可能降级；发行物与资源需匹配 | | 挂载 | loadURL后等UI/客户端settle | 不是只看HTTP，但仍非任务验收 | | 会话 | 底座模型流→工具→结果→下一步 | 继承DSH，不算新推理算法 | | 网页 | browser工具→pane bridge/CDP或独立Edge | locator/权限/SSRF各有条件，见Q02/3 | | 交接/退出 | 人核代码/网页结果，停后台/浏览器 | 动作回包不是业务完成，保留差异/残留 | #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[apps/deepseekgui/package.json:1-18](https://github.com/See-Sol-Lab/DeepSeekGUI/blob/1e913d8b38b23df083bd6d3852b623f93210360a/apps/deepseekgui/package.json#L1-L18) 真实应用版本/main。
查看原文（18行） ```text { "name": "@see-sol-lab/deepseekgui", "description": "DeepSeek-native Harness-first desktop host and Workbench foundation", "version": "1.2.1", "private": true, "repository": { "type": "git", "url": "git+https://github.com/See-Sol-Lab/DeepSeekGUI.git", "directory": "apps/deepseekgui" }, "type": "module", "main": "lib/main.js", "license": "SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE", "devDependencies": { "@types/node": "^22.20.0", "@types/ws": "8.18.1", "@xterm/addon-fit": "^0.11.0", "@xterm/xterm": "^6.0.0", ```

|\n\n*同一个本地工作台，两种主题。点击图片可查看原始尺寸。*\n\n![内置浏览器与会话并列](docs/user/deepseekgui/assets/browser-1.1.1.png)\n\n*在会话旁边打开网页，查看助手的浏览操作和结果，让对话与页面内容保持并列。*\n\n![会话与右侧文件栏](docs/user/deepseekgui/assets/file-sidebar-1.1.1.png)\n\n*更新后兼容官方右侧文件栏，可与助手同时浏览工作区文件。*\n\n![模型配置与桌面管理](docs/user/deepseekgui/assets/settings-1.1.1.png)\n\n*在统一设置中配置模型，支持最新v4.1并做好视觉提示词注入，设置面板内置自研插件与功能调试。*\n\n![Git 阅读、可修改、也可让助手整理的项目级记忆*\n\n![全局记忆](docs/user/deepseekgui/assets/global-memory-1.1.0.png)\n\n*跨项目的个人偏好与全局记忆由用户编辑保存，助手读取；可同时编辑AGENTS.md*\n\n## 工作台功能\n\n### 本地项目与 Git 协作\n\n- **改动视图** — 按将提交、已改动、新文件和冲突分组查看文件，打开单文件差异、复制路径或在文件管理器中定位。\n- **Git 视图** — 查看分支、远端同步状态、最近提交，以及已加载会话记录中的提交、推送和 PR 结果。\n- **并行工作区** — 集成在 Git 视图上方，查看已注册 worktree 的分支与改动，标出共同修改的路径，方便检查潜在冲突。\n- **Git / PR 工具** — 通过会话查询差异、暂存、取消暂存、撤销已跟踪文件的未暂存改动、提交、预览推送、推送和创建 PR；结果以专用卡片展示。\n- **本地状态检查** — 视图按需读取工作区状态，无需模型请求；工作区文件路径可点击定位，内置终端可跟随当前会话目录。\n\n### 记忆与协作规则\n\n- **全局记忆** — 用户在设置页编辑跨项目偏好与协作要求，助手只读；保存时检查原文和当前 Home，避免旧草稿覆盖外部修改。\n- **项目记忆** — 助手在工作区的 `<文件夹名>.memory.md` 中维护项目事实；记忆视图支持 Markdown 阅读和「让助手整理」。\n- **规则模板** — 托管目录首次启动时初始化全局 `AGENTS.md`，项目模板可按需生成；已有文件保留。\n- **可追溯上下文** — 会话加载时读取两层记忆，实际使用的内容随 Harness 会话上下文记录保存。\n\n### 模型与桌面工具\n\n- **模型与附件** — 支持 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，支持自定义模型服务、通用文件上传和图片附件；图片及网页截图交给支持视觉的模型。\n- **会话与权限** — 在项目文件夹中开始和恢复会话，查看工具执行过程，通过 Harness 权限模式和审批控制操作；回复正文平滑显示，停止或结束后立即显示完整内容。\n- **归档与删除** — 在「设置 → 归档的会话」恢复或确认删除。删除等待当前回复与工具执行结束，清理正文和搜索索引，保留最小删除记录；共享附件文件保留。\n- **浏览器与终端** — 网页在应用内与会话并列，助手打开网页时自动展开；浏览器面板与文件侧栏交替显示。DSH Terminal 使用当前 Harness 环境，可跟随会话目录。\n- **文件预览** — 右侧文件栏支持多标签、分栏、全屏及 Markdown、代码、HTML、PDF、图片预览，在对话旁检查助手交付的文件。\n- **桌面通知** — 接收待审批、待回答及后台任务完成或失败的提示，点击跳转到对应会话。\n- **Profile 与插件** — 切换 Harness Home 和 Profile，管理兼容插件，查看配置与运行状态。\n- **更新与数据迁移** — 自动下载更新并校验 SHA256，由用户确认安装；可关闭自动下载。托管数据目录支持迁移，复制与校验完成后切换，旧副本经确认再清理。\n- **首次使用与诊断** — 首次启动可用 DeepSeek 账号登录或添加 API Key，登录后的官方引导介绍额度与用法；提供中英双语、系统托盘、本地诊断导出和助手辅助的 BUG 排查。\n\n完整版本变更见 [v1.2.1 发布说明](https://github.com/See-Sol-Lab/DeepSeekGUI/releases/tag/v1.2.1)。\n\n## 文档\n\n| 指南 | |\n| --- | --- |\n| [快速开始](docs/user/deepseekgui/quickstart.zh.md) | 账号登录或 API Key、模型配置、第一次会话 |\n| [数据与故障排查](docs/user/deepseekgui/data-troubleshooting.zh.md) | 数据目录迁移、卸载保留、隐私、故障排查 |\n\n文档里也保留了上游 Harness 的开发教程和插件开发参考。\n\n## 数据与隐私\n\n托管环境中的凭据、设置、会话与全局记忆保存在应用本地数据目录；Windows 默认为 `%APPDATA%\\DeepSeekGUI\\dsh`。项目记忆保存在所选工作区的 `<文件夹名>.memory.md` 中。模型请求会将当前任务所需的上下文发送到你配置的模型服务；浏览网页、Git / PR、插件管理和更新检查也会访问相应网络服务。\n\n日志对凭据类内容进行脱敏，诊断文件保存在本地。Windows 卸载程序会询问是否删除应用数据；覆盖升级保留数据。分享诊断或提交项目记忆文件前，请检查其中是否包含私密内容。\n\n## 从源码构建\n\n<a id=\"run-deepseekgui-from-source\"></a>\n\n### 从源码运行 DeepSeekGUI\n\n需要仓库指定版本的 Node.js 和 pnpm：\n\n```sh\ngit clone https://github.com/See-Sol-Lab/DeepSeekGUI.git\ncd DeepSeekGUI\npnpm install\npnpm run build\npnpm run dev:deepseekgui\n```\n\n构建 Windows 发行版：\n\n```sh\npnpm run build:desktop-dist\n```\n\n打包细节见 [DeepSeekGUI Desktop](apps/deepseekgui/README.zh.md)。\n\n<a id=\"run\"></a>\n\n### 通过 npm 运行 Harness\n\n装好 Node.js，启动上游 Web UI：\n\n```sh\nnpx @deepseek-ai/dsh web\n```\n\n会在浏览器打开 Restarting DeepSeekGUI picks a different port.',\n  )\n}\n\n/** Flatten the model tree into a ref → (role, name) table for locator resolution. */\nexport function collectRefs(nodes: readonly A11yNode[], out: Map<string, { role: string; name: string }>): void {\n  for (const node of nodes) {\n    out.set(node.ref, { role: node.role, name: node.name })\n    collectRefs(node.children, out)\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Total nodes one snapshot may produce.\n *\n * The depth cap alone does not bound the work: a single level of a generated\n * page can hold tens of thousands of siblings, and all of them end up in the\n * model's context as well as in memory here.\n */\nexport const A11Y_MAX_NODES = 5_000\n\n/** Height ceiling for a full-page screenshot, in CSS pixels. */\nexport const SCREENSHOT_MAX_HEIGHT = 20_000\n\n/**\n * Ceiling for a single page operation (click, fill, hover, scroll).\n *\n * It has to stay clear of the tool-level timeout above it, which is 30s for\n * most tools. '', name: node.name?.value ?? '', value: node.value?.value ?? '', children })\n      produced++\n    }\n    for (const childId of (node.childIds ?? []).toReversed()) {\n      const child = byId.get(childId)\n      if (child !== undefined) stack.push({ node: child, parentPath: path, into: children })\n    }\n  }\n  return out\n}\n\n/**\n * The shared browser manager. Callers go through {@link resolveTarget}, which narrows the\n   * matches to one visible element.\n   * @param loc - the model-facing locator.\n   * @param page - the target page.\n   * @returns the playwright locator (possibly matching several elements).\n   */\n  private resolveLocator(loc: ElementLocator, page: Page): import('playwright-core').Locator {\n    if (loc.selector !== undefined && loc.selector !== '') return page.locator(loc.selector)\n    if (loc.role !== undefined && loc.role !== '') {\n      return page.getByRole(loc.role as never, loc.name !== undefined && loc.name !== '' ? { name: loc.name } : {})\n    }\n    if (loc.ref !== undefined && loc.ref !== '') {\n      if (this.refPage !== page || this.refUrl !== page.url()) throw new Error('snapshot references belong to another page; take a new browser_snapshot')\n      const entry = this.refTable.get(loc.ref)\n      if (entry !== undefined && entry.role !== '') {\n        return page.getByRole(entry.role as never, { name: entry.name, exact: true })\n      }\n    }\n    if (loc.text !== undefined && loc.text !== '') return page.getByText(loc.text, { exact: false })\n    throw new Error('locator: none of ref/text/selector/role resolved to an element — snapshot the page first')\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * The one element an interaction acts on: the first VISIBLE match.\n   *\n   * Three failures of the old \"first match, wait until actionable\" rule, all\n   * from one site that renders every card of every page into the DOM and\n   * lets pagination toggle visibility (2026-09-11 manual test round 3):\n   * text \"查看详情\" on page 2 resolved to a hidden page-1 card and waited the\n   * full timeout for it to become visible; a CSS selector matching 213 cards\n   * threw a strict-mode violation listing them; and a name that matched\n   * nothing at all also sat for the full timeout. Now: nothing attached\n   * within a short window → \"no element matches\"; matches but none visible →\n   * says so with the count; otherwise the first visible one, in document\n   * order — what \"click the first card\" means.\n   * @param loc - the model-facing locator.\n   * @param page - the target page.\n   * @returns a locator pinned to exactly one visible element.\n   */\n  private async resolveTarget(loc: ElementLocator, page: Page): Promise<import('playwright-core').Locator> {\n    const matches = this.resolveLocator(loc, page)\n    const target = await firstVisibleMatch(matches, describeLocator(loc))\n    if (loc.ref !== undefined && !loc.selector && !loc.role && await matches.filter({ visible: true }).count() !== 1) {\n      throw new Error('snapshot reference matches multiple visible elements; use a unique selector or text instead')\n    }\n    return target\n  }\n\n  async click(loc: ElementLocator, button: 'left' | 'right'): Promise<void> {\n    await this.ensure()\n    const page = this.activePage()\n    await (await this.resolveTarget(loc, page)).click({ button })\n  }\n\n  async inspectClickTarget(loc: ElementLocator): Promise<ClickTargetFacts | null> {\n    await this.ensure()\n    const page = this.activePage()\n    try {\n      return await (await this.resolveTarget(loc, page)).evaluate((node): ClickTargetFacts => {\n        // This callback runs inside the page, but it is type-checked here in\n        // the Node build, which has no DOM lib — hence the structural shape\n        // instead of HTMLElement.\n        const element = node as unknown as {\n          tagName: string\n          innerText?: string\n          getAttribute: (name: string) => string | null\n          closest: (selector: string) => unknown\n        }\n        const attribute = (name: string): string | null => element.getAttribute(name)?.toLowerCase() ?? null\n        const label = [\n          element.innerText ?? '',\n          attribute('aria-label') ?? '',\n          attribute('value') ?? '',\n          attribute('title') ?? '',\n          attribute('name') ?? '',\n        ].join(' ').toLowerCase()\n        return {\n          tag: element.tagName.toLowerCase(),\n          type: attribute('type'),\n          role: attribute('role'),\n          label,\n          inForm: element.closest('form') !== null,\n        }\n      })\n    } catch {\n      // Element gone, detached, or not readable: the caller treats null as\n      // \"unknown\", which fails closed into asking the user.\n      return null\n    }\n  }\n\n  async type(loc: ElementLocator, text: string, clearFirst: boolean, pressEnter: boolean): Promise<void> {\n    await this.ensure()\n    const page = this.activePage()\n    const target = await this.resolveTarget(loc, page)\n    const editable = await target.evaluate((node) => {\n      const element = node as unknown as { tagName: string; type?: string; isContentEditable?: boolean }\n      const tag = element.tagName.toLowerCase()\n      return element.isContentEditable === true || tag === 'textarea'\n        || (tag === 'input' && !['button', 'submit', 'reset', 'checkbox', 'radio', 'file', 'hidden', 'color', 'range', 'image'].includes(element.type ?? 'text'))\n    })\n    if (!editable) throw new Error('browser_type requires an editable input, textarea, or contenteditable element')\n    if (clearFirst) {\n      await target.fill(text)\n    } else {\n      await target.focus()\n      await page.keyboard.type(text, { delay: 8 })\n    }\n    if (pressEnter) await page.keyboard.press('Enter')\n  }\n\n  async scroll(direction: 'up' | 'down' | 'top' | 'bottom', amount: number, loc: ElementLocator | null): Promise<void> {\n    await this.ensure()\n    const page = this.activePage()\n    if (loc !== null && (loc.ref !== undefined || loc.text !== undefined || loc.selector !== undefined || loc.role !== undefined)) {\n      await (await this.resolveTarget(loc, page)).scrollIntoViewIfNeeded()\n      return\n    }\n    if (direction === 'top' || direction === 'bottom') {\n      await page.evaluate(`window.scrollTo(0, ${direction === 'top' ? '0' : 'document.body.scrollHeight'})`)\n      return\n    }\n    const delta = direction === 'down' ? amount : -amount\n    await page.evaluate(`window.scrollBy(0, ${delta})`)\n  }\n\n  async keyboard(keys: string): Promise<void> {\n    await this.ensure()\n    await this.activePage().keyboard.press(keys)\n  }\n\n  async hover(loc: ElementLocator): Promise<void> {\n    await this.ensure()\n    await (await this.resolveTarget(loc, this.activePage())).hover()\n  }\n\n  async submit(loc: ElementLocator): Promise<void> {\n    await this.ensure()\n    await (await this.resolveTarget(loc, this.activePage())).click()\n  }\n\n  async navigate(url: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<{ finalUrl: string; this is the last-hop confirmation).\n    const settled = await validateNavigationTarget(finalUrl, this.options.lookup)\n    if (!settled.ok) {\n      throw new Error(`navigation landed on a blocked target: ${settled.detail}`)\n    }\n    return { finalUrl, title: await page.title() }\n  }\n\n  async snapshot(maxDepth: number): Promise<{ title: string; url: string; nodes: A11yNode[]; text: string }> {\n    await this.ensure()\n    const page = this.activePage()\n    // The shell's own empty-state page is never what the caller wants to\n    // read (DS 验房 2026-09-06: after a long wait the pane had been rebuilt\n    // and snapshot quietly returned the placeholder copy).\n    if (isPanePlaceholder(page.url(), await page.title().catch(() => ''))) {\n      throw new Error('the embedded browser pane shows its empty placeholder page (it was reopened or rebuilt); call browser_navigate again before reading it')\n    }\n    // A dead page (failed commit or renderer crash) reads as an empty tree;\n    // say the page is gone instead of reporting an empty success (B6-4).\n    if (isChromiumErrorPage(page.url())) {\n      throw new Error('the browser page failed to load (Chromium error page); call browser_navigate again to reload it')\n    }\n    const nodes = cdpTreeToNodes(await cdpAccessibilityTree(page), maxDepth)\n    // Cache the ref → (role, name) table so interaction tools can resolve\n    // snapshot refs into ARIA locators without re-reading the tree.\n    this.refTable.clear()\n    collectRefs(nodes, this.refTable)\n    this.refPage = page\n    this.refUrl = page.url()\n    return { title: await page.title(), url: page.url(), nodes, text: await pageText(page) }\n  }\n\n  async screenshot(fullPage: boolean): Promise<string> {\n    await this.ensure()\n    const page = this.activePage()\n    if (isPanePlaceholder(page.url(), await page.title().catch(() => ''))) {\n      throw new Error('the embedded browser pane shows its empty placeholder page (it was reopened or rebuilt); call browser_navigate again before taking a screenshot')\n    }\n    if (isChromiumErrorPage(page.url())) {\n      throw new Error('the browser page failed to load (Chromium error page); call browser_navigate again before taking a screenshot')\n    }\n    let buffer: Buffer\n    try {\n      buffer = fullPage ? await this.boundedFullPageShot(page) : await page.screenshot({ type: 'png' })\n    } catch (error) {\n      // A hidden or not-yet-composited pane has no bitmap; The panel is the user's to open — say so instead of\n        // popping it (2026-09-11 manual test #22).\n        throw new Error('the embedded browser pane is hidden (the user collapsed it), so there is nothing to capture; ask the user to open the browser panel (the globe button), then retry — navigating to a new address also opens it')\n      }\n      throw error\n    }\n    const { mkdirSync, writeFileSync } = await import('node:fs')\n    const { join } = await import('node:path')\n    mkdirSync(this.options.screenshotDir, { recursive: true })\n    const stamp = new Date().toISOString().replace(/[:.]/g, '-')\n    const file = join(this.options.screenshotDir, `browser-${stamp}-${randomUUID()}.png`)\n    writeFileSync(file, buffer, { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 })\n    return file\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Full-page screenshot with a height ceiling.\n   *\n   * An infinite-scroll page can report a document tens of thousands of pixels\n   * tall; `fullPage: true` then asks the compositor for one bitmap that size\n   * and writes the whole thing to disk. navigate in place instead')\n      if (action === 'close') throw new Error('the embedded browser panel is single-tab and stays open; the user closes it with the panel\\'s ✕')\n      const page = this.activePage()\n      return [{ index: 0, url: page.url(), title: await page.title().catch(() => '') }]\n    }\n    const context = this.context\n    if (context === null) throw new Error('browser not launched')\n    // 'switch' 不在下面出现是刻意的：它在这个 facade 上无事可做——下标住在\n    // 调用方的参数里，切换由 tools 层调 selectTab() 完成。\n    if (action === 'new') {\n      this.refTable.clear()\n      await context.newPage()\n      this.activeTabIndex = context.pages().length - 1\n    } else if (action === 'close') {\n      const pages = context.pages()\n      const which = index ?? this.activeTabIndex\n      const target = pages[which]\n      if (target === undefined) throw new Error(`no tab at index ${String(which)} (${String(pages.length)} open)`)\n      if (pages.length === 1) throw new Error('the last tab stays open; []\n    if (index < 0 || index >= pages.length) throw new Error(`no tab at index ${index}`)\n    this.refTable.clear()\n    this.activeTabIndex = index\n  }\n\n  private async tabList(): Promise<TabInfo[]> {\n    const context = this.context\n    if (context === null) return []\n    const pages = context.pages()\n    return Promise.all(pages.map(async (page, index) => ({\n      index,\n      url: page.url(),\n      title: await page.title().catch(() => ''),\n    })))\n  }\n\n  async currentUrl(): Promise<string> {\n    await this.ensure()\n    return this.activePage().url()\n  }\n\n  async close(): Promise<void> {\n    this.closed = true\n    await this.launchQueue?.catch(() => undefined)\n    this.refTable.clear()\n    this.refPage = null\n    // Pane mode: collapse the pane in the shell, then just disconnect —\n    // connectOverCDP's close() drops the session without killing the shell.\n    if (this.panePage !== null && this.options.paneBridge !== undefined) {\n      await paneHide(this.options.paneBridge).catch(() => undefined)\n    }\n    this.panePage = null\n    if (this.browser !== null) {\n      await this.browser.close().catch(() => undefined)\n      this.browser = null\n      this.context = null\n    }\n    if (this.proxy !== null) {\n      await this.proxy.close().catch(() => undefined)\n      this.proxy = null\n    }\n    this.launchQueue = null\n  }\n}\n"

      "path": "apps/deepseekgui/browser-plugin/src/gate.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * Browser capability permission gate — the L0/L1/L2 policy mapped onto the\n * official session sandbox mode and the ApprovalService (菲博 §7.1.3).\n *\n * - L0 (read-only browsing: navigate/snapshot/screenshot/wait/tabs) always\n *   allowed; navigating is reading the web, not mutating it.\n * - L1 (page interaction: click/type/scroll/keyboard) is REFUSED in\n *   read-only sessions — browser interaction is a side effect on the outside\n *   world and is not exempted by \"does not write the workspace\". Allowed in\n *   workspace-write / danger-full-access sessions without an approval prompt.\n * - L2 (form submission / messaging / login) always goes through the official\n *   ApprovalService; a missing approval service fails closed (P6-B rule).\n *\n * B2 ships L0 tools only; the L1/L2 policy is fully implemented and tested\n * now so the M3 interaction tools register against an already-proven gate.\n *\n * @module @see-sol-lab/deepseekgui-browser/gate\n */\n\n/** The capability's internal tool levels. */\nexport type BrowserToolLevel = 'L0-read' | 'L1-interact' | 'L2-sensitive'\n\n/** Tools the B2 read-only surface registers. */\nexport const B2_READ_TOOLS = ['browser_navigate', 'browser_snapshot', 'browser_screenshot', 'browser_wait', 'browser_tabs'] as const\n\n/** Tools the M3 interaction surface registers. */\nexport const M3_INTERACT_TOOLS = ['browser_click', 'browser_type', 'browser_scroll', 'browser_keyboard', 'browser_hover'] as const\n\n/**\n * What a click is about to land on. Filled in by the browser layer just\n * before the click; null when the element could not be inspected at all.\n */\nexport interface ClickTargetFacts {\n  /** Lowercased tag name, e.g. `button`, `a`, `input`. */\n  tag: string\n  /** The `type` attribute for inputs and buttons, lowercased. */\n  type: string | null\n  /** Explicit ARIA role, lowercased. */\n  role: string | null\n  /** Visible text, aria-label, value and title, joined and lowercased. */\n  label: string\n  /** Whether the element sits inside a `<form>`. */\n  inForm: boolean\n}\n\n/**\n * Words that name an action with consequences outside this browser: money\n * moves, data is destroyed, something gets published, a session is created.\n *\n * Deliberately NOT in this list: confirm / ok / save / continue / 确定 / 保存.\n * They appear on cookie banners, accordions and dialogs constantly, and\n * asking about every one of them would make the browser unusable — while the\n * submit-button rules below already cover the real form submissions those\n * words usually sit on.\n */\nconst CONSEQUENTIAL_WORDS = [\n  'submit', 'send', 'login', 'log in', 'sign in', 'signin', 'sign up', 'signup',\n  'register', 'subscribe', 'buy', 'purchase', 'order', 'checkout', 'pay',\n  'payment', 'donate', 'delete', 'remove', 'destroy', 'publish', 'transfer',\n  '提交', '发送', '发表', '发布', '登录', '登陆', '注册', '订阅', '购买',\n  '下单', '结算', '支付', '付款', '捐赠', '删除', '移除', '转账',\n] as const\n\n/**\n * Does this click need the same approval `browser_submit` asks for?\n *\n * The capability promises that submitting requires approval, but a click can\n * press the very same button — so the promise only holds if consequential\n * clicks go through the same door. Judged from the element itself rather than\n * from which tool was called.\n * @param facts - what the click will land on; null when it could not be read.\n * @returns true when the user must approve before the click happens.\n */\nexport function clickNeedsApproval(facts: ClickTargetFacts | null): boolean {\n  // Could not read the element: it might be anything, so fail closed.\n  if (facts === null) return true\n  if (facts.type === 'submit' || facts.type === 'image') return true\n  // A <button> inside a form submits it unless it opts out with type=\"button\".\n  if (facts.tag === 'button' && facts.inForm && facts.type !== 'button') return true\n  if (facts.role === 'button' && facts.inForm) return true\n  return CONSEQUENTIAL_WORDS.some(word => facts.label.includes(word))\n}\n\n/**\n * Can this keystroke submit whatever currently has focus?\n *\n * Enter was already gated, but only when spelled exactly \"enter\": NumpadEnter\n * submits a form just as well, and Space activates a focused button. Matching\n * on the final key of the combination covers \"Control+Enter\" too.\n * @param keys - the key string as the tool received it.\n * @returns true when the keystroke can trigger a submit.\n */\nexport function keystrokeCanSubmit(keys: string): boolean {\n  if (keys.split('+').pop() === ' ') return true\n  const last = keys.trim().toLowerCase().split('+').pop()?.trim() ?? ''\n  return last === 'enter' || last === 'numpadenter' || last === 'return' || last === 'space'\n}\n\n/** Tools that mutate external state and require approval (form submit / send / login). */\nexport const L2_TOOLS = ['browser_submit'] as const\n\n/** Classify a tool name into its gate level; unknown tools refuse (fail closed). */\nexport function browserToolLevel(toolName: string): BrowserToolLevel {\n  if ((B2_READ_TOOLS as readonly string[]).includes(toolName)) return 'L0-read'\n  if ((M3_INTERACT_TOOLS as readonly string[]).includes(toolName)) return 'L1-interact'\n  if ((L2_TOOLS as readonly string[]).includes(toolName)) return 'L2-sensitive'\n  return 'L1-interact' // unknown browser_* tools are treated as interactive\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether a tool must contact the ApprovalService before running. Only L2:\n * an L0/L1 call must never raise an approval card (验收修正 2026-08-23 —\n * the unconditional request made every read-only call pop an empty card).\n */\nexport function requiresApproval(toolName: string): boolean {\n  return browserToolLevel(toolName) === 'L2-sensitive'\n}\n\n/**\n * The human-readable reason rendered on the L2 approval card (验收基准\n * §7.3.7): which site receives data, through which element — bilingual, the\n * installer-card convention (the plugin has no locale channel of its own).\n */\nexport function submitApprovalReason(origin: string, target: string): string {\n  return `浏览器将在 ${origin} 提交表单/发送内容（目标元素：${target}）。`\n    + ` Browser will submit a form / send content on ${origin} (element: ${target}).`\n}\n\n/** Session sandbox mode (mirrors @deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-policy's mode union). */\nexport type SandboxMode = 'read-only' | 'workspace-write' | 'danger-full-access'\n\n/** Outcome of the gate for one tool call. */\nexport type GateDecision =\n  | { kind: 'allow' }\n  | { kind: 'deny'; reason: 'read-only-session' | 'approval-unavailable' | 'approval-rejected' }\n\n/**\n * Apply the gate for one tool call. L2 always needs an approval outcome\n * supplied by the caller (null = approval service missing → fail closed).\n * @param toolName - the tool being called.\n * @param sandboxMode - the session's effective sandbox mode.\n * @param approvalOutcome - for L2: the ApprovalService outcome; null when the\n *   service is absent. Ignored for L0/L1.\n * @returns the decision.\n */\nexport function checkBrowserAction(\n  toolName: string,\n  sandboxMode: SandboxMode,\n  approvalOutcome: 'allowed-once' | 'rejected' | 'cancelled' | 'unavailable' | null,\n): GateDecision {\n  const level = browserToolLevel(toolName)\n  switch (level) {\n    case 'L0-read':\n      return { kind: 'allow' }\n    case 'L1-interact':\n      // Browser interaction mutates external state: never in read-only.\n      return sandboxMode === 'read-only'\n        ? { kind: 'deny', reason: 'read-only-session' }\n        : { kind: 'allow' }\n    case 'L2-sensitive':\n      // L2 ⊃ L1: submitting posts data to a remote origin, which is strictly\n      // more consequential than the clicks L1 already refuses here. Without\n      // this line a read-only session refused browser_click yet allowed\n      // browser_submit the moment the user tapped the approval card.\n      if (sandboxMode === 'read-only') {\n        return { kind: 'deny', reason: 'read-only-session' }\n      }\n      if (approvalOutcome === null || approvalOutcome === 'unavailable') {\n        return { kind: 'deny', reason: 'approval-unavailable' }\n      }\n      return approvalOutcome === 'allowed-once'\n        ? { kind: 'allow' }\n        : { kind: 'deny', reason: 'approval-rejected' }\n  }\n}\n"

      "content": "/**\n * DeepSeekGUI browser capability plugin.\n *\n * Registers three tiers of tools over one headed Edge instance driven through\n * a loopback SSRF proxy:\n *\n * - read (L0): browser_navigate / snapshot / screenshot / wait / tabs\n * - interact (L1): browser_click / type / scroll / keyboard / hover\n * - sensitive (L2, always approved): browser_submit\n *\n * A read-only session refuses everything above L0. Above that, the gate is not\n * decided by which tool was called: a click that lands on a submit button, or\n * a keystroke that can submit a form, goes through the same approval as\n * browser_submit — otherwise the L2 promise would be trivially bypassable.\n * Navigation is SSRF-checked before any network byte moves (菲博 §7.1.5:\n * gate first, look later).\n *\n * Install: `dsh plugin add @see-sol-lab/deepseekgui-browser` (registry) or a\n * packed tarball. The plugin declares dsh.bundle.patch, so reconcile adds it\n * to the profile's bundle layer stack automatically. playwright-core resolves\n * from the profile's node_modules — never from the DeepSeekGUI private runtime.\n *\n * @module @see-sol-lab/deepseekgui-browser\n */\n\nimport type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'\nimport z from '@deepseek-ai/schemastery'\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-policy'\nimport type {} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-user-approval'\nimport { DeepSeekGUIBrowser } from './browser.ts'\nimport { applyBrowserTools, applyInteractionTools } from './tools.ts'\nimport { nodeLookup } from './ssrf.ts'\nimport { paneBridgeFromEnv } from './pane.ts'\n\nexport const name = 'deepseekgui-browser'\n\n/** Services required by the browser capability. */\nexport const inject = ['tools', 'systemPrompt', 'sandboxPolicy', 'approval']\n\n/** Plugin config (B2): enablement and browser launch knobs. */\nexport interface Config {\n  /** Register the browser tools. Defaults to true. */\n  enabled?: boolean\n  /** Playwright channel; defaults to the system Edge. */\n  channel?: string\n  /** Headed by default; headless is for tests only. */\n  headless?: boolean\n  /** Screenshot output directory; defaults to $DEEPSEEKGUI_USERDATA/deepseekgui-browser/screenshots. */\n  screenshotDir?: string\n  /**\n   * Prefer the in-window embedded pane when running inside DeepSeekGUI (B3-11).\n   * Defaults to true; false forces the separate headed-Edge window even when\n   * the shell bridge is available.\n   */\n  embedded?: boolean\n}\n\nexport const Config: z<Config> = z.object({\n  enabled: z.boolean().default(true),\n  channel: z.string().default('msedge'),\n  headless: z.boolean().default(false),\n  screenshotDir: z.string(),\n  embedded: z.boolean().default(true),\n})\n\n/**\n * Mount the browser capability: one shared browser manager plus the read and\n * interaction toolsets. The browser is lazily launched on first tool call and\n * torn down on plugin dispose. Apply failures degrade to \"no browser tools\" — the plugin\n * must never drag the whole composition down at boot (DeepSeekGUI convention,\n * same as the settings plugin's apply guard).\n * @param ctx - cordis context with tools/systemPrompt/sandboxPolicy/approval.\n * @param config - resolved plugin config.\n */\nexport function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): void {\n  try {\n    applyInner(ctx, config)\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(`[deepseekgui-browser] apply failed: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`)\n  }\n}\n\nfunction applyInner(ctx: Context, config: Config): void {\n  if (config.enabled === false) return\n  // B3-11: inside DeepSeekGUI the shell hands us its pane bridge via env — the\n  // tools then drive the Codex-style in-window pane. Outside DeepSeekGUI (or\n  // with embedded=false) the same tools drive a separate headed Edge window.\n  const bridge = config.embedded === false ? null : paneBridgeFromEnv(process.env)\n  const browser = new DeepSeekGUIBrowser({\n    lookup: { lookup: nodeLookup },\n    ...config.channel !== undefined && config.channel !== '' ? { channel: config.channel } : {},\n    ...config.headless !== undefined ? { headless: config.headless } : {},\n    ...config.screenshotDir !== undefined && config.screenshotDir !== '' ? { screenshotDir: config.screenshotDir } : {},\n    ...bridge !== null ? { paneBridge: bridge } : {},\n  })\n  applyBrowserTools(ctx, browser)\n  applyInteractionTools(ctx, browser)\n  // effect disposer：fiber 销毁时关闭浏览器与代理（cordis 清理语义）。\n  ctx.effect(() => {\n    return () => { void browser.close() }\n  })\n}\n"
    },

      "path": "apps/deepseekgui/browser-plugin/src/pane.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * Embedded browser-pane bridge client (B3-11).\n *\n * When the plugin runs inside a DeepSeekGUI-spawned harness, the desktop shell\n * passes its loopback control-bridge address via DEEPSEEKGUI_BROWSER_BRIDGE\n * (`127.0.0.1:<port>#<token>`). Through it the plugin asks Electron to open\n * the in-window browser pane (a WebContentsView beside the official UI,\n * Codex-style split), points the pane's session at the plugin's SSRF proxy,\n * and receives the CDP endpoint to drive the pane via connectOverCDP.\n *\n * Outside DeepSeekGUI the variable is absent and the plugin falls back to the\n * windowed headed-Edge mode — same tools, same gate, different chrome.\n *\n * @module @see-sol-lab/deepseekgui-browser/pane\n */\n\n/** Parsed bridge address. */\nexport interface PaneBridge {\n  /** `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` — loopback only, never remote. */\n  origin: string\n  /** Shared token; the bridge 404s without it (no distinguishable probe signal). */\n  token: string\n}\n\n/**\n * Parse DEEPSEEKGUI_BROWSER_BRIDGE from the environment.\n * @param env - process environment.\n * @returns the bridge address, or null when not running inside DeepSeekGUI.\n */\nexport function paneBridgeFromEnv(env: Record<string, string | undefined>): PaneBridge | null {\n  const raw = env.DEEPSEEKGUI_BROWSER_BRIDGE\n  if (raw === undefined || raw === '') return null\n  const hash = raw.indexOf('#')\n  if (hash <= 0 || hash === raw.length - 1) return null\n  const host = raw.slice(0, hash)\n  const token = raw.slice(hash + 1)\n  // Loopback only: refuse anything that is not 127.0.0.1:<port>.\n  if (!/^127\\.0\\.0\\.1:\\d{1,5}$/.test(host)) return null\n  return { origin: `http://${host}`, token }\n}\n\n/** POST one action to the pane endpoint; throws on transport or HTTP error. */\nasync function paneCall(bridge: PaneBridge, body: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {\n  const response = await fetch(`${bridge.origin}/control/browser-pane`, {\n    method: 'POST',\n    headers: {\n      'content-type': 'application/json',\n      'x-deepseekgui-control-token': bridge.token,\n    },\n    body: JSON.stringify(body),\n  })\n  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`browser-pane bridge: HTTP ${String(response.status)}`)\n  const data: unknown = await response.json()\n  return typeof data === 'object' && data !== null ? data as Record<string, unknown> : {}\n}\n\n/**\n * Ask the shell to create/show the pane.\n * @param bridge - bridge address.\n * @returns the CDP port and the pane's current URL (the connect-time target key).\n */\nexport async function paneEnsure(bridge: PaneBridge): Promise<{ cdpPort: number; paneUrl: string }> {\n  const data = await paneCall(bridge, { action: 'ensure' })\n  const cdpPort = data.cdpPort\n  const paneUrl = data.paneUrl\n  if (typeof cdpPort !== 'number' || typeof paneUrl !== 'string') {\n    throw new Error('browser-pane bridge: malformed ensure response')\n  }\n  return { cdpPort, paneUrl }\n}\n\n/**\n * Point the pane session's proxy at the plugin's SSRF proxy — every hop of\n * every navigation still passes the same validation as windowed mode.\n * @param bridge - bridge address.\n * @param rules - Chromium proxyRules string.\n */\nexport async function paneSetProxy(bridge: PaneBridge, rules: string): Promise<void> {\n  await paneCall(bridge, { action: 'set-proxy', rules })\n}\n\n/**\n * Collapse the pane (view survives hidden; the user can reopen from the menu).\n * @param bridge - bridge address.\n */\nexport async function paneHide(bridge: PaneBridge): Promise<void> {\n  await paneCall(bridge, { action: 'hide' })\n}\n\n/**\n * Slide the pane out (2026-09-11 manual test #22): every navigation to a new\n * address opens the panel, whether or not the user collapsed it earlier —\n * asking the assistant to look at a site means wanting to see it open. The\n * user can collapse it again; nothing but the next navigation reopens it.\n * @param bridge - bridge address.\n */\nexport async function paneReveal(bridge: PaneBridge): Promise<void> {\n  await paneCall(bridge, { action: 'reveal' })\n}\n"
    },

      "path": "apps/deepseekgui/browser-plugin/src/proxy.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * Local SSRF proxy — the enforcement point of the navigation gate.\n *\n * The browser context is forced through this loopback proxy. Every request\n * (including every redirect hop, which the browser re-issues through the\n * proxy) runs `validateNavigationTarget` first; on pass, the proxy connects\n * to the CHECKED IP with the original Host header, so the browser never\n * resolves DNS itself and a DNS-rebinding attempt cannot reach a private\n * address. HTTPS goes through a CONNECT tunnel (TCP-only, no MITM: the\n * browser's TLS handshake passes through untouched).\n *\n * Only loopback-bound; no credentials; no request body inspection beyond URL.\n *\n * @module @see-sol-lab/deepseekgui-browser/proxy\n */\n\nimport { createServer, request as httpRequest, type IncomingMessage, type ServerResponse } from 'node:http'\nimport { connect as netConnect, isIP, type LookupFunction } from 'node:net'\nimport type { Duplex } from 'node:stream'\nimport type { HostLookup } from './ssrf.ts'\nimport { validateNavigationTarget } from './ssrf.ts'\n\n/** CONNECT tunnels are only permitted for TLS (and thus only 443). */\nconst ALLOWED_CONNECT_PORTS = new Set([443])\n\n/**\n * A resolver that always answers with the one address the SSRF check already\n * cleared, whatever it is asked.\n *\n * This is what actually pins the connection. Passing the IP as `host` looks\n * equivalent but is not: it makes the IP the HTTP authority, and it leaves the\n * door open for a global agent (Node 24 honours `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY` and\n * `HTTP_PROXY`) to re-resolve the real hostname somewhere outside the check.\n * With a pinned lookup the authority stays honest AND the socket can only land\n * on the address we vetted.\n * @param ip - the address {@link validateNavigationTarget} approved.\n * @returns a lookup function usable as `http.request({ lookup })`.\n */\nexport function pinnedLookup(ip: string): LookupFunction {\n  const family = isIP(ip) === 6 ? 6 : 4\n  return ((_hostname: string, options: unknown, callback: unknown): void => {\n    // Node expects an array when `options.all` is set and a bare address\n    // otherwise; answering in the wrong shape breaks the request outright.\n    const all = typeof options === 'object' && options !== null && (options as { all?: boolean }).all === true\n    const done = callback as (\n      error: NodeJS.ErrnoException | null,\n      address: string | { address: string; family: number }[],\n      family?: number,\n    ) => void\n    if (all) done(null, [{ address: ip, family }])\n    else done(null, ip, family)\n  }) as unknown as LookupFunction\n}\n\n/**\n * Split a CONNECT authority into host and port, IPv6 literals included.\n *\n * `split(':')` cannot do this: `[2001:db8::1]:443` carries colons inside the\n * host, so the old parser handed back `[2001` and a NaN port, and every IPv6\n * tunnel died at the gate.\n * @param target - the raw CONNECT request target.\n * @returns host (unbracketed) and port, or null when malformed.\n */\nexport function parseConnectAuthority(target: string | undefined): { host: string; port: number } | null {\n  const raw = (target ?? '').trim()\n  if (raw === '') return null\n  if (raw.startsWith('[')) {\n    // Bracketed form: [addr]:port. Split on the closing bracket rather than\n    // on colons, which the address itself is full of.\n    const close = raw.indexOf(']:')\n    if (close === -1) return null\n    const host = raw.slice(1, close)\n    const port = Number(raw.slice(close + 2))\n    return isIP(host) === 6 && Number.isInteger(port) ? { host, port } : null\n  }\n  const lastColon = raw.lastIndexOf(':')\n  if (lastColon <= 0) return null\n  const host = raw.slice(0, lastColon)\n  const port = Number(raw.slice(lastColon + 1))\n  // A bare IPv6 literal without brackets is not a valid authority: its own\n  // colons are indistinguishable from the port separator.\n  if (host === '' || host.includes(':') || !Number.isInteger(port)) return null\n  return { host, port }\n}\n\n/** Wrap an IPv6 address back in brackets so it can be put into a URL. */\nfunction toUrlAuthority(host: string): string {\n  return isIP(host) === 6 ? `[${host}]` : host\n}\n\n/** A running SSRF proxy. */\nexport interface SsrfProxy {\n  /** The loopback port browsers must route through. */\n  port: number\n  /** Stop accepting connections and release the port. */\n  close(): Promise<void>\n}\n\n/** Human-safe error body shown in the browser for blocked targets. */\nfunction blockedPage(detail: string): string {\n  return [\n    '<!doctype html><html><body style=\"font-family:system-ui;padding:24px\">',\n    '<h2>Navigation blocked</h2>',\n    `<p>${escapeHtml(detail)}</p>`,\n    '<p>The DeepSeekGUI browser refuses targets that resolve to local, private, or reserved networks.</p>',\n    '</body></html>',\n  ].join('')\n}\n\nfunction escapeHtml(text: string): string {\n  return text.replace(/[&<>\"']/g, char => ({\n    '&': '&', '<': '<', '>': '>', '\"': '"', \"'\": ''',\n  })[char]!)\n}\n\n/**\n * Start the loopback SSRF proxy. Each proxied request validates its URL\n * through {@link validateNavigationTarget} and forwards to the checked IP.\n * @param lookup - DNS injection (the proxy resolves, never the browser).\n * @returns the running proxy handle.\n */\nexport function startSsrfProxy(lookup: HostLookup): Promise<SsrfProxy> {\n  // Every socket the proxy is holding. `server.close()` only stops accepting\n  // new connections — it then waits for the existing ones, and a CONNECT\n  // tunnel can stay open for as long as the page wants. Without this set,\n  // closing the browser could hang on a socket nobody is watching.\n  const sockets = new Set<Duplex>()\n  const track = (socket: Duplex): void => {\n    sockets.add(socket)\n    socket.once('close', () => { sockets.delete(socket) })\n  }\n\n  const server = createServer((request, response) => {\n    // The handler is async, so a rejection here would be an unhandled one and\n    // the browser would sit waiting for a response that never comes.\n    void handlePlainRequest(request, response, lookup).catch(() => {\n      if (response.destroyed || response.headersSent) response.destroy()\n      else response.writeHead(502).end('proxy error')\n    })\n  })\n  server.on('connection', (socket) => { track(socket) })\n  server.on('connect', (request, clientSocket, head) => {\n    // An upgraded socket is detached from the server's own bookkeeping, so it\n    // has to be tracked here too or close() will never see it.\n    track(clientSocket)\n    void handleConnect(request.url, clientSocket, head, lookup).catch(() => {\n      clientSocket.destroy()\n    })\n  })\n\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    // A listen failure (port exhaustion, permissions) arrives as an 'error'\n    // event. With nobody listening for it the startup promise never settled\n    // and never rejected — the pane just hung.\n    const onStartupError = (error: Error): void => {\n      reject(new Error(`ssrf proxy failed to start: ${error.message}`))\n    }\n    server.once('error', onStartupError)\n    server.listen(0, '127.0.0.1', () => {\n      server.removeListener('error', onStartupError)\n      const address = server.address()\n      if (address === null || typeof address === 'string') {\n        // Throwing inside this callback would escape the promise entirely.\n        server.close()\n        reject(new Error('ssrf proxy: unexpected address shape'))\n        return\n      }\n      let closing: Promise<void> | undefined\n      resolve({\n        port: address.port,\n        close: () => closing ??= new Promise((done) => {\n          for (const socket of sockets) socket.destroy()\n          sockets.clear()\n          server.close(() => { done() })\n        }),\n      })\n    })\n  })\n}\n\n/** Plain HTTP: validate, then forward to the checked IP with the original Host. */\nasync function handlePlainRequest(\n  request: IncomingMessage,\n  response: ServerResponse,\n  lookup: HostLookup,\n): Promise<void> {\n  if (request.url === undefined) {\n    response.writeHead(400).end('bad request')\n    return\n  }\n  // A proxy receives the request-target in ABSOLUTE form (RFC 7230 §5.3.2):\n  // `GET http://host/path HTTP/1.1`. Only a client that ignores proxy rules\n  // sends origin-form, and only then does the Host header complete it.\n  // Concatenating Host + url unconditionally (the previous shape) produced\n  // `http://hosthttp://host/path`: with a port it threw in `new URL`, without\n  // one it resolved a garbage `hosthttp` hostname — every plain-HTTP\n  // navigation through the pane 502'd, and only HTTPS (the CONNECT path)\n  // worked.\n  const absolute = /^https?:\\/\\//i.test(request.url)\n    ? request.url\n    : `http://${request.headers.host ?? 'invalid'}${request.url}`\n  const verdict = await validateNavigationTarget(absolute, lookup)\n  if (response.destroyed || response.writableEnded) return\n  if (!verdict.ok) {\n    response.writeHead(502, { 'content-type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8' })\n    response.end(blockedPage(verdict.detail))\n    return\n  }\n  const target = verdict.ips[0]\n  if (target === undefined) {\n    response.writeHead(502).end('no address')\n    return\n  }\n  let upstreamUrl: URL\n  try {\n    upstreamUrl = new URL(absolute)\n  } catch {\n    response.writeHead(502).end('bad target')\n    return\n  }\n  const forwarded = httpRequest({\n    // The original hostname stays the HTTP authority; `lookup` below is what\n    // decides which address the socket actually reaches.\n    host: upstreamUrl.hostname,\n    // The target's own port, not a hardcoded 80 — `http://host:8080/` used to\n    // be dialled on 80. Port is not the SSRF axis here (the connection always\n    // goes to the already-validated IP); the CONNECT path stays 443-only\n    // because a raw tunnel is opaque, while this request is one we compose.\n    port: upstreamUrl.port === '' ? 80 : Number(upstreamUrl.port),\n    method: request.method,\n    // Origin-form upstream: we are talking to the origin server, not to\n    // another proxy, and many servers reject an absolute-URI target with 400.\n    path: `${upstreamUrl.pathname}${upstreamUrl.search}`,\n    headers: request.headers,\n    // Never inherit the global agent: under Node 24 it honours the ambient\n    // proxy env vars and would route this request through a hop we never\n    // checked, dissolving the \"checked IP == connected IP\" guarantee.\n    agent: false,\n    lookup: pinnedLookup(target),\n  }, (upstream) => {\n    upstream.on('error', () => { response.destroy() })\n    if (response.destroyed) {\n      upstream.destroy()\n      return\n    }\n    response.writeHead(upstream.statusCode ?? 502, upstream.headers)\n    upstream.pipe(response)\n  })\n  forwarded.on('error', () => {\n    // 浏览器侧可能已断开（close-to-browser 竞态）：对已销毁的 response\n    // 写入会变成 unhandled ECONNABORTED——先查状态，写不动就销毁。\n    if (!response.destroyed) {\n      response.writeHead(502).end('upstream error')\n    } else {\n      response.destroy()\n    }\n  })\n  // 浏览器断开时中止转发，避免向上游写已死连接；请求流错误同样吞掉。\n  response.on('close', () => { forwarded.destroy() })\n  request.on('error', () => { forwarded.destroy() })\n  request.pipe(forwarded)\n}\n\n/** CONNECT: validate host, then open a raw TCP tunnel to the checked IP:port. */\nasync function handleConnect(\n  target: string | undefined,\n  clientSocket: Duplex,\n  head: Buffer,\n  lookup: HostLookup,\n): Promise<void> {\n  const authority = parseConnectAuthority(target)\n  if (authority === null || !ALLOWED_CONNECT_PORTS.has(authority.port)) {\n    clientSocket.write('HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\\r\\n\\r\\n')\n    clientSocket.destroy()\n    return\n  }\n  const { host, port } = authority\n  const verdict = await validateNavigationTarget(`https://${toUrlAuthority(host)}/`, lookup)\n  if (!verdict.ok) {\n    clientSocket.write(`HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\\r\\nX-DeepSeekGUI-Block: ${escapeHtml(verdict.detail)}\\r\\n\\r\\n`)\n    clientSocket.destroy()\n    return\n  }\n  const checkedIp = verdict.ips[0]\n  if (checkedIp === undefined) {\n    clientSocket.write('HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\\r\\n\\r\\n')\n    clientSocket.destroy()\n    return\n  }\n  const upstream = netConnect({ host: checkedIp, port })\n  upstream.once('connect', () => {\n    // 浏览器侧可能在隧道建立前已断开：写入已销毁的 socket 会触发 error。\n    if (clientSocket.destroyed) {\n      upstream.destroy()\n      return\n    }\n    clientSocket.write('HTTP/1.1 200 Connection Established\\r\\n\\r\\n')\n    if (head.length > 0) upstream.write(head)\n    clientSocket.pipe(upstream)\n    upstream.pipe(clientSocket)\n  })\n  // 浏览器断开/网络抖动时写失败会触发 error：无监听即 unhandled。吞掉并销毁。\n  clientSocket.on('error', () => { clientSocket.destroy() })\n  upstream.once('error', () => {\n    if (!clientSocket.destroyed) {\n      clientSocket.write('HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\\r\\n\\r\\n')\n    }\n    clientSocket.destroy()\n  })\n  clientSocket.once('close', () => { upstream.destroy() })\n  upstream.once('close', () => { clientSocket.destroy() })\n}\n"
    },
    {
      "path": "apps/deepseekgui/browser-plugin/src/ssrf.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * SSRF-safe navigation gate for the DeepSeekGUI browser capability.\n *\n * Pure, network-free half: URL hygiene, IP classification, and the\n * resolve-then-check decision every navigation target must pass BEFORE any\n * network byte moves. The proxy layer (browser-proxy.ts) is the enforcement\n * point: it resolves through this module, connects to the checked IP, and\n * re-checks every redirect hop. No localhost/private/link-local/metadata\n * target is ever reachable — including DeepSeekGUI's own 3080/control bridge,\n * which is a feature, not an exception (菲博 §7.1.5).\n *\n * @module @see-sol-lab/deepseekgui-browser/ssrf\n */\n\n/** A blocked target classification, for machine-readable reasons. */\ntype BlockReason =\n  | 'unsupported-scheme'\n  | 'url-too-long'\n  | 'credentials-in-url'\n  | 'invalid-host'\n  | 'blocked-ip'\n\n/** Result of one navigation-target validation. */\nexport type TargetVerdict =\n  | { ok: true; host: string; ips: readonly string[] }\n  | { ok: false; reason: BlockReason; detail: string }\n\n/** DNS lookup injection (tests mock it; the proxy uses node:dns). */\nexport interface HostLookup {\n  lookup(host: string): Promise<readonly string[]>\n}\n\n/** Inclusive CIDR check over a parsed 32-bit IPv4 address. */\nfunction ipv4InCidr(value: number, base: number, prefix: number): boolean {\n  const mask = prefix === 0 ? 0 : (~0 << (32 - prefix)) >>> 0\n  return (value & mask) === (base & mask)\n}\n\n/** Parse a dotted-quad IPv4 string into its 32-bit form; NaN on failure. */\nexport function parseIpv4(text: string): number {\n  const parts = text.split('.')\n  if (parts.length !== 4) return Number.NaN\n  let value = 0\n  for (const part of parts) {\n    if (!/^\\d{1,3}$/.test(part)) return Number.NaN\n    const octet = Number(part)\n    if (octet > 255) return Number.NaN\n    value = (value << 8) | octet\n  }\n  return value >>> 0\n}\n\n/**\n * Whether an IPv4 address is a SSRF-relevant block: loopback, private,\n * CGNAT, link-local (incl. cloud metadata 169.254.169.254), documentation,\n * benchmarking, multicast, reserved. Everything else is treated as public.\n * @param value - parsed 32-bit IPv4.\n * @returns true when the address must never be connected to.\n */\nfunction isBlockedIpv4(value: number): boolean {\n  return ipv4InCidr(value, 0x0000_0000, 8) // 0.0.0.0/8 — \"this network\"\n    || ipv4InCidr(value, 0x0a00_0000, 8) // 10.0.0.0/8 — private\n    || ipv4InCidr(value, 0x6440_0000, 10) // 100.64.0.0/10 — CGNAT\n    || ipv4InCidr(value, 0x7f00_0000, 8) // 127.0.0.0/8 — loopback\n    || ipv4InCidr(value, 0xa9fe_0000, 16) // 169.254.0.0/16 — link-local + metadata\n    || ipv4InCidr(value, 0xac10_0000, 12) // 172.16.0.0/12 — private\n    || ipv4InCidr(value, 0xc000_0000, 24) // 192.0.0.0/24 — IETF protocol\n    || ipv4InCidr(value, 0xc000_0200, 24) // 192.0.2.0/24 — documentation\n    || ipv4InCidr(value, 0xc0a8_0000, 16) // 192.168.0.0/16 — private\n    || ipv4InCidr(value, 0xc612_0000, 15) // 198.18.0.0/15 — benchmarking\n    || ipv4InCidr(value, 0xc633_6400, 24) // 198.51.100.0/24 — documentation\n    || ipv4InCidr(value, 0xcb00_7100, 24) // 203.0.113.0/24 — documentation\n    || ipv4InCidr(value, 0xe000_0000, 4) // 224.0.0.0/4 — multicast\n    || ipv4InCidr(value, 0xf000_0000, 4) // 240.0.0.0/4 — reserved\n}\n\n/**\n * Parse an IPv6 literal into its eight 16-bit groups.\n *\n * Text-prefix matching is not enough for this family: `::1` also spells as\n * `0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1`, and an IPv4-mapped address spells both `::ffff:127.0.0.1`\n * and `::ffff:7f00:1`.       "content": "/** Electron lifecycle and proxy policy for the external browser pane. */\nimport type { Session, WebContents } from 'electron'\n\n/**\n * Route every pane request, including loopback redirects, through its SSRF proxy.\n * @param session - The pane's isolated Electron Session.\n * @param proxyRules - Local SSRF proxy address.\n * @returns Completion of Chromium's proxy configuration.\n */\nexport function configureBrowserPaneProxy(session: Pick<Session, 'setProxy'>, proxyRules: string): Promise<void> {\n  return session.setProxy({ proxyRules, proxyBypassRules: '<-loopback>' })\n}\n\n/**\n * Release a crashed pane after Electron finishes dispatching its crash event.\n * @param contents - External-page WebContents.\n * @param release - Release this exact pane if it is still owned by the window.\n */\nexport function releaseCrashedPane(contents: Pick<WebContents, 'once'>, release: () => void): void {\n  contents.once('render-process-gone', () => { setImmediate(release) })\n}\n"

Host 推账号状态：account 路由只收\n * `{ view, session }` 一帧，内容由 main 严格校验（见 desktop-account.ts）。它同样经\n * env 进子进程，所以同样只开这一扇门。页面里的 platform 路由用页面自己的\n * 控制凭证：那是官方账号界面请求打开/移动/关闭内嵌平台页的出口。\n *\n * pane 日志所在目录。\n * @param base - current 日志的文件名。\n * @returns 同族文件名（升序）；目录不可读时为空数组。\n */\nexport function logFamilyNames(dir: string, base: string): string[] {\n  const shape = new RegExp(`^${base.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\\]\\\\]/g, '\\\\$&')}(\\\\.\\\\d+)?$`)\n  try {\n    return readdirSync(dir).filter(name => shape.test(name)).sort()\n  } catch {\n    return []\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 创建 DSH 子进程的本地诊断日志。打开前执行有限轮转（最多 5 份 +\n * 总大小 budget，最老先删）：crash 证据不会被下一次启动立刻冲掉。\n * 按 UTF-8 字节限长。凭据可能被 stream 边界任意拆开（多字节 UTF-8\n * 字符同理）：字节经 StringDecoder 组装完整字符，文本经共享的\n * {@link createStreamingRedactor} 扣住\"未完待续\"的可疑片段，判定完整\n * 后才落盘——所有凭据形态与 `redactSecrets` 同一套规则。\n * 日志自身的任何失败只会使日志静默失效，绝不向主进程抛异常。\n * @param path - Buffer.byteLength(LOG_TRUNCATION_MARKER)\n  const decoder = new StringDecoder('utf8')\n  const redactor = createStreamingRedactor()\n  let written = 0\n  let truncated = false\n  let closed = false\n  const emit = (redacted: string): void => {\n    if (fd === undefined || closed || truncated || redacted.length === 0) return\n    try {\n      const bytes = Buffer.byteLength(redacted)\n      if (written + bytes > budget) {\n        truncated = true\n        writeSync(fd, LOG_TRUNCATION_MARKER)\n        return\n      }\n      written += bytes\n      writeSync(fd, redacted)\n    } catch {\n      // 磁盘满、句柄失效等：日志失效即止，不影响主进程。\n      truncated = true\n    }\n  }\n  return {\n    write(chunk) {\n      emit(redactor.push(typeof chunk === 'string' ? chunk : decoder.write(chunk)))\n    },\n    close() {\n      if (closed) return\n      emit(redactor.push(decoder.end()) + redactor.flush())\n      closed = true\n      if (fd !== undefined) {\n        try {\n          closeSync(fd)\n        } catch {\n          // 句柄已失效：没有可释放的资源。\n        }\n      }\n    },\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * 选一个能监听的端口：首选端口能绑定（或只是被占用）就原样返回；Windows\n * 把它划进保留范围（Hyper-V/WinNAT，netsh 的 excludedportrange，绑定报\n * EACCES）时改由系统分配一个空闲端口。占用仍交给 {@link portInUse} 报错。\n * 只在保留时才换：端口是页面 origin 的一部分，换了浏览器存储就换了一份。\n * @param host - Date.now()))\n      const probeTimer = setTimeout(() => { controller.abort() }, budget)\n      void fetch(`http://${host}:${port}/`, { signal: controller.signal }).then(\n        () => {\n          clearTimeout(probeTimer)\n          succeed()\n        },\n        () => {\n          clearTimeout(probeTimer)\n          if (settled) return\n          const now = Date.now()\n          retryTimer = setTimeout(\n            probe,\n            now - startedAt < PROBE_FAST_WINDOW_MS ? PROBE_FAST_INTERVAL_MS : PROBE_INTERVAL_MS,\n          )\n        },\n      )\n    }\n    probe()\n  })\n}\n\n/**\n * 停止一个子进程：先请求终止，宽限期内未退出则强制终止。\n * Windows 上终止整棵进程树：`kill()` 的 TerminateProcess 只到达直接子进程，\n * DSH 服务正在运行的工具子进程（pwsh、pty helper）会成为孤儿；\n * `taskkill /T /F`（System32 内置）终止整棵树。POSIX 上仍发 SIGTERM，\n * 由 dsh 的信号处理优雅退出并清理自己的子进程。\n * @param child - 目标子进程。\n * @param timeoutMs - 宽限时间。\n * @returns 进程退出后 resolve。\n */\nexport function stopProcess(\n  child: ChildProcess,\n  timeoutMs = STOP_TIMEOUT_MS,\n  // 可注入的整树终止器（测试用）；默认 taskkill /T /F。windowsHide：\n  // taskkill 是控制台子系统二进制，打包 GUI（无控制台）下不加会每次\n  // 终止都闪一个黑框。\n  spawnTreeKill: (pid: number) => ChildProcess = pid => spawn('taskkill', ['/pid', String(pid), '/T', '/F'], { stdio: 'ignore', windowsHide: true }),\n  hardTimeoutMs = STOP_HARD_TIMEOUT_MS,\n  zh = true,\n): Promise<void> {\n  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {\n    if (child.exitCode !== null || child.signalCode !== null) {\n      resolve()\n      return\n    }\n    let settled = false\n    const timer = setTimeout(() => {\n      child.kill('SIGKILL')\n    }, timeoutMs)\n    // 最终期限：SIGKILL 也可能失败（权限不足、进程卡在不可中断的系统调用）。\n    // 原先只等 exit 事件，那种情况下 quit / restart 会永远等下去。\n    const hardTimer = setTimeout(() => {\n      if (settled) return\n      settled = true\n      clearTimeout(timer)\n      reject(new ProcessStopError(zh\n        ? `子进程（pid ${String(child.pid ?? 'unknown')}）在 ${String(hardTimeoutMs)}ms 内没有退出`\n        : `The child process (pid ${String(child.pid ?? 'unknown')}) did not exit within ${String(hardTimeoutMs)}ms`))\n    }, hardTimeoutMs)\n    child.once('exit', () => {\n      if (settled) return\n      settled = true\n      clearTimeout(timer)\n      clearTimeout(hardTimer)\n      resolve()\n    })\n    if (process.platform === 'win32' && child.pid !== undefined) {\n      const killer = spawnTreeKill(child.pid)\n      // taskkill 不可用（error）或非零退出（权限不足等）而目标仍在运行时，\n      // 回退为直接终止子进程；树内孙进程此时无法保证。\n      killer.once('error', () => child.kill())\n      killer.once('exit', (code) => {\n        if (code !== 0 && child.exitCode === null && child.signalCode === null) child.kill()\n      })\n      return\n    }\n    child.kill()\n  })\n}\n"
